text:
Maria Chen: quick sync — we need an acceptability matrix + sig-test plan for FP8/INT8/4-bit additions. who owns the matrix and what metrics do we gate on?
Ajay Patel: +1. suggest start with tok-level perplexity delta, exact-match for QA, and ROUGE for summarization. set tolerances per-bitwidth.
Devin Torres: also add embedding cosine drop for retrieval endpoints. can run A/B harness on staging.
Sophie Li: per-endpoint SLOs matter — conversational latency/quality tradeoffs differ. we should have separate rows for short-chat vs longctx summarization.
Ravi Kumar: question: synthetic prompt sets vs real customer prompts. i'd prefer a two-tier sample: 10k synthetic across behaviors + 1k anonymized real for critical endpoints.
ops-bot: note: will need new telemetry tags: quant_profile, baseline_model, sample_bucket. ops can add those once schema approved.
Ajay Patel: initial tolerances (proposal):
```
bitwidth | metric                | max_change
FP8      | perplexity (tok)      | +5% 
INT8     | perplexity (tok)      | +3% 
4-bit    | perplexity (tok)      | +8% 
FP8      | QA EM                 | -1.5 pts
INT8     | QA EM                 | -0.8 pts
4-bit    | QA EM                 | -3.0 pts
```
Devin Torres: these numbers look reasonable as a starting heuristic. we'll need to convert to p-values for statistical significance across runs.
Sophie Li: can we add a small human evaluation for edge-lingua cases? even 200 annotations catch weird regressions.
Ravi Kumar: +1 on humans. also add long-context alignment tests — check for factual drift at 4k/16k windows.
qa-bot: suggested CI gating: block merge if any endpoint sees metric delta > threshold on staging; allow opt-out for flagged experimental branches with an "experimental/quant" tag.
Maria Chen: draft owner plan: eng-ml for matrix & tests, eng-runtime for telemetry + rollout hooks, QA for CI gating & human evals. Sophie volunteer to run the first canary?
Sophie Li: i'll run the canary next week. will schedule 2k convo samples + 500 longctx.
Devin Torres: i'll wire the A/B harness and an automated p-value check. need a stable seed and 10 repeats to reduce noise.
Ajay Patel: also add a qualitative degradation score: combine metric deltas into a 0-100 score so product folk can interpret. simple formula: 100 - sum(weighted_norm_deltas).
Maria Chen: perfect. next steps: (1) finalise matrix in this thread by EOD Friday, (2) ops to add telemetry tags, (3) QA to add gating rules, (4) run small FP8 canary.
Ravi Kumar: FYI I'll prepare longctx prompt sets and anonymize them.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-2847 for telemetry changes.
Maria Chen: thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source. ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:
